description: This Java class provides utility methods for generating test response objects related to 'Thing' entities, including handling of eTags and variations in response types. It is used in testing scenarios for the 'Ditto' IoT framework to simplify creation of consistent mock responses.

classes.name: ETagTestUtils
classes.description: This utility class provides static methods to generate test responses for 'Thing' entities, including handling eTags and various response types for testing the 'Ditto' framework.

methods.name: retrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveThingResponse with a given expected Thing, its JSON representation, and headers, appending an eTag.

methods.name: retrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveThingResponse with a given expected Thing and headers, generating JSON from the Thing and appending an eTag.

methods.name: modifyThingResponse
methods.description: Generates a ModifyThingResponse for a modified Thing, updating its revision and attaching an eTag.

methods.name: sudoRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a SudoRetrieveThingResponse for a given Thing, its JSON, and headers, with an eTag.

methods.name: modifyFeaturesResponse
methods.description: Creates a ModifyFeaturesResponse indicating creation or modification, with eTag handling.

methods.name: retrieveFeaturesResponse
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveFeaturesResponse with expected features and headers, including eTag.

methods.name: retrieveFeatureResponse
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveFeatureResponse for a specific feature, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: modifyFeatureResponse
methods.description: Generates a ModifyFeatureResponse for a feature, indicating creation or modification, with headers.

methods.name: modifyFeatureDefinitionResponse
methods.description: Creates a response indicating creation or modification of a feature definition, with eTag.

methods.name: retrieveFeatureDefinitionResponse
methods.description: Creates a response with a feature definition and headers, including eTag.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertiesResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for modifying feature properties, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: retrieveFeaturePropertiesResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving feature properties, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: retrieveFeaturePropertiesResponse
methods.description: An overload to return a response with expected feature properties.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertyResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for modifying a feature property, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: retrieveFeaturePropertyResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving a feature property, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: modifyAttributesResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for modifying attributes, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: retrieveAttributesResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving attributes, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: modifyAttributeResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for modifying a single attribute, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: retrieveAttributeResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving a single attribute, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: modifyAclResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for modifying ACL, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: retrieveAclResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving ACL, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: modifyAclEntryResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for modifying an ACL entry, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: retrieveAclEntryResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving an ACL entry, with headers and eTag.

methods.name: modifyPolicyIdResponse

methods.name: retrievePolicyIdResponse
